name: shoemaker-status
description: Shows the status of your Shoemaker projects (rounds, timer, queue) in the status line and a /shoemaker pane

autoOpen.title: Open the pane by itself
autoOpen.description: project: when the session starts inside a Shoemaker project's repository, workspace or state directory; always; or never (use /shoemaker)

pollSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the status is read again
